messages.author: baf78f9118cbd54b
messages.subject: GLAD and CBS model
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to follow the copy number analysis to different Affymetrix
SNP chips under the aroma.affymetrix homepages. I noticed that for 10
to 500K copy number analysis, people use GLAD model, while in the 5.0&
6.0 analysis, CBS model is used. Is there some preference between the
two models?

Thanks,

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8

I'm not sure if you mean "my vignettes" when you refer to "people". I
tend to use CBS more because it is faster, especially for the new
larger chip types. I won't be answering their relative
statistical/biological performance - there have been some studies -
but I'm happy with both.

/Henrik
